choice.basis: The plotted production series for Factory F starts at the 3,500 tick in 2018 and ends just above the 2,000 tick in 2023, indicating a net production decrease over the 2018-2023 review period. Although the chart title says 'Increasing Production', the visual data (the actual operations record) shows a decline from 3,500 to ~2,100. The task asks to review the dashboard record and choose the follow-up route for the production trend. A net decrease corresponds to the decline response route.
